text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Today's objective is simple... Head to the 
convenience store and retrieve the 
package.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Still, going out, huh... *sigh* If only 
there were a route that cut down the 
travel time—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, really? Could it actually exist? 
If we pass through the tree-lined avenue, 
break through the shopping arcade, and 
then head straight down into the 
basement—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought! It can be omitted after 
all! ...Heh-heh, hahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What a simple game—I didn't even need to 
use Warnsdorff's rule!
